roles/dataflow.admin.title: Dataflow Admin
roles/dataflow.admin.desc: Minimal role for creating and managing dataflow jobs.

roles/dataflow.developer.title: Dataflow Developer
roles/dataflow.developer.desc: Provides the permissions necessary to execute and manipulate Dataflow jobs.

roles/dataflow.serviceAgent.title: Cloud Dataflow Service Agent
roles/dataflow.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Cloud Dataflow service account access to managed resources. Includes access to service accounts.

roles/dataflow.viewer.title: Dataflow Viewer
roles/dataflow.viewer.desc: Provides read-only access to all Dataflow-related resources.

roles/dataflow.worker.title: Dataflow Worker
roles/dataflow.worker.desc: Provides the permissions necessary for a Compute Engine service account to execute work units for a Dataflow pipeline.
